comparison.objective: Candidate depins an electrical terminal; record holds and hammers a nail into a post.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade insertion, wire deflection, and coordinated extraction versus one-arm nail stabilization while the other repeatedly strikes with a hammer.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires intact selective removal but lacks exact force/damage thresholds. Record scores nail depth beyond 4 cm and zeros on arm-arm or hammer-controlled-arm contact; finer final alignment/release thresholds are not specified.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is generic; impact fastening and collision avoidance are unlike latch release.
